nodes.name: idbobjectstore.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the IDBObjectStore DOM interface for performing CRUD operations on IndexedDB object stores, including put, add, delete, get, cursor iteration, and index management.
nodes.languageNotes: Largest file in the IndexedDB module with the full 40-method IDBObjectStore interface including inline key paths and key generator management.

nodes.name: KeyPath
nodes.summary: Enum representing an IndexedDB key path, which can be a single string or a sequence of strings for compound keys.

nodes.name: IDBObjectStore
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing an IndexedDB object store handle with its name, key path, index set, abort rollback state, and key generator.

nodes.name: IDBObjectStoreAbortState
nodes.summary: Struct tracking the abort state for an object store during a transaction, including newly-created flag, rollback indexes, and key generator number.

nodes.name: new_inherited
nodes.summary: Constructs the inherited IDBObjectStore fields with key path extraction, key generator initialization, and abort state setup.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor reflecting a new IDBObjectStore DOM object with database name, store name, options, abort state, and transaction reference.

nodes.name: restore_metadata_after_abort
nodes.summary: Restores the object store metadata after an upgrade transaction abort, reverting name, index set, and key generator state.

nodes.name: clone_value_in_target_realm
nodes.summary: Clones a JS value using structured serialize/deserialize, temporarily deactivating the transaction to prevent reentrancy.

nodes.name: generate_key_for_put
nodes.summary: Generates a new auto-increment key from the key generator, validating the 2^53 limit.

nodes.name: possibly_update_the_key_generator
nodes.summary: Updates the key generator current number if the given numeric key exceeds it, clamping to 2^53.

nodes.name: put
nodes.summary: Implements the core add-or-put algorithm with inline key path extraction, key generation, value cloning, structured serialization, and async request execution.

nodes.name: open_cursor
nodes.summary: Opens a cursor on the object store by creating an IDBCursor or IDBCursorWithValue and issuing an async iterate operation with the backend.

nodes.name: add_index
nodes.summary: Creates and registers a new IDBIndex handle on this object store with the given name, options, and key path.

nodes.name: Put
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.put() delegating to the put method with no-overwrite flag set to false.

nodes.name: Add
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.add() delegating to the put method with no-overwrite flag set to true.

nodes.name: Delete
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.delete() by converting the query to a key range and issuing an async remove operation.

nodes.name: Clear
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.clear() by issuing an async clear operation to remove all records.

nodes.name: Get
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.get() by converting the query to a key range and issuing an async retrieve operation.

nodes.name: GetKey
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.getKey() by issuing an async get-key operation for the given query range.

nodes.name: GetAll
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.getAll() retrieving all matching values with an optional count limit.

nodes.name: GetAllKeys
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.getAllKeys() retrieving all matching keys with an optional count limit.

nodes.name: Count
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.count() counting records matching a key range.

nodes.name: SetName
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.setName() renaming the object store during a versionchange transaction.

nodes.name: CreateIndex
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.createIndex() creating a new index with key path validation, backend sync operation, and handle registration.

nodes.name: DeleteIndex
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.deleteIndex() removing an index during a versionchange transaction.

nodes.name: Index
nodes.summary: Implements IDBObjectStore.index() retrieving an index handle by name from the store index set.

nodes.name: idbopendbrequest.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the IDBOpenDBRequest DOM interface for handling database open requests, including upgrade transactions, success/error dispatching, and delete operations.

nodes.name: IDBOpenDBRequest
nodes.summary: DOM struct extending IDBRequest with a pending connection reference and unique UUID for backend communication.

nodes.name: handle_delete_db
nodes.summary: Handles the result of a delete-database operation, dispatching success or error events on the associated open request.

nodes.name: get_or_init_connection
nodes.summary: Lazily initializes the pending IDBDatabase connection for this open request.

nodes.name: upgrade_db_version
nodes.summary: Runs the upgrade transaction steps from the spec: setting the connection, dispatching the upgradeneeded event, and handling auto-commit or abort.

nodes.name: delete_database
nodes.summary: Sends a delete-database SyncOperation to the storage backend with a callback for processing the result.

nodes.name: dispatch_success
nodes.summary: Dispatches a success event on the open request after a database connection is established, setting the result to the database handle.

nodes.name: dispatch_blocked
nodes.summary: Dispatches a blocked event on the open request when a database open is blocked by other connections.

nodes.name: idbrequest.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the IDBRequest DOM interface and the async execution framework for IndexedDB operations, managing request lifecycle, event dispatching, and structured clone deserialization.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses a generic RequestListener pattern with typed callbacks to bridge between asynchronous backend operations and DOM event dispatching.

nodes.name: IdbResult
nodes.summary: Enum representing the possible results of an IndexedDB async operation, including keys, values, count, and cursor iteration data.

nodes.name: IDBRequest
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing an IndexedDB request, holding the result, error, source object store, transaction reference, and ready state.

nodes.name: execute_async
nodes.summary: Generic function implementing the async execution algorithm: creates or reuses a request, registers it with the transaction, sends the operation to the backend, and returns the request with a callback for result handling.

nodes.name: handle_async_request_finished
nodes.summary: Processes the result of an async operation: deserializes structured clones, handles iterate cursor results, sets the request result, and fires success events with proper transaction state management.

nodes.name: handle_async_request_error
nodes.summary: Handles async operation failures by setting the request error, firing error events, and initiating transaction abort if the error is unhandled.

nodes.name: idbtransaction.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the IDBTransaction DOM interface with full lifecycle management including commit, abort, request tracking, and versionchange upgrade handling.
nodes.languageNotes: Manages the full transaction state machine with request-level accounting for auto-commit detection.

nodes.name: IDBTransaction
nodes.summary: DOM struct holding the full transaction state: mode, durability, store handles, request list, active/finished/abort flags, cleanup event loop, and serial number.

nodes.name: new_with_serial
nodes.summary: Reflects a new IDBTransaction DOM object with a pre-assigned backend serial number.

nodes.name: create_transaction
nodes.summary: Sends a blocking CreateTransaction SyncOperation to the backend and receives the assigned serial number.

nodes.name: attempt_commit
nodes.summary: Attempts to commit the transaction by sending a Commit SyncOperation to the backend with a callback for handling the result.

nodes.name: maybe_commit
nodes.summary: Conditionally triggers an auto-commit if all requests have been handled, no pending requests remain, and the transaction is not finished or aborted.

nodes.name: initiate_abort
nodes.summary: Initiates an abort on the transaction, restoring versionchange state and setting the error, while preventing double-abort.

nodes.name: request_backend_abort
nodes.summary: Sends an abort SyncOperation to the storage backend with a callback for finalization.

nodes.name: finalize_abort
nodes.summary: Finalizes an abort by queueing a task to dispatch the abort event, restore versionchange state, clear upgrade transaction, and unregister.

nodes.name: dispatch_complete
nodes.summary: Queues a task to dispatch the complete event, clear upgrade transaction references, and unregister from the global scope.

nodes.name: ObjectStore
nodes.summary: Implements IDBTransaction.objectStore() returning or creating an object store handle within the transaction scope, with index restoration for versionchange transactions.

nodes.name: Commit
nodes.summary: Implements IDBTransaction.commit() explicitly committing the transaction by setting it inactive and forcing a commit attempt.

nodes.name: Abort
nodes.summary: Implements IDBTransaction.abort() explicitly aborting the transaction via the lifecycle abort path.

nodes.name: idbversionchangeevent.rs
nodes.summary: Implements the IDBVersionChangeEvent DOM interface for dispatching versionchange, upgradeneeded, and blocked events with old/new version tracking.

nodes.name: IDBVersionChangeEvent
nodes.summary: DOM struct representing a version change event with old and new version properties.

nodes.name: new
nodes.summary: Public constructor creating a new IDBVersionChangeEvent with type, bubble/cancelable flags, and version info.

nodes.name: fire_version_change_event
nodes.summary: Implements the fire-a-version-change-event algorithm from the spec, creating and dispatching the event with legacy output listener tracking.

nodes.name: mod.rs
nodes.summary: Parent module file that re-exports all 11 IndexedDB submodules as pub(crate) items.
